user_requested_defaults.fee_applies_to: every buy and sell, including opening and closing
user_requested_defaults.turnover: daily actual position changes, including marked position drift and equity changes
user_requested_defaults.weighting: Daily equal notional weights within long and short sides, including quantity rebalancing of retained names
user_requested_defaults.buffer_rule: Keep long names while in top30%, replace vacancies from top10% in descending score order; short side mirrored. Daily equal weighting; retain names, not unchanged quantities.

metrics.sharpe: daily net mean / sample daily standard deviation * sqrt(365), risk-free rate zero
metrics.calmar: annualized compounded net return / maximum drawdown
metrics.maximum_drawdown: from daily net equity, including initial equity
metrics.IC: Default IC means Rank IC (Spearman): cross-sectional Pearson correlation of factor average-tie ranks and forward24h price excess return average-tie ranks; annual average of daily correlations.
metrics.ICIR: Mean daily Rank IC / sample standard deviation, unannualized unless explicitly requested
metrics.Pearson_IC: Legacy Pearson statistics must be explicitly labeled Pearson IC, never bare IC.

missing_data: Never silently replace: disclose estimated days and assumptions in each result

active_factor_set.instruction: Use original15 including range_to_quote_volume_2; no funding-rate features.

current_training.window: Expanding2021 through previous year; annual refit to predict next year
current_training.factor_input: Raw15 factors; target remains next24h fullpool excess return
